name: @hermes/design-system-builder
description: Local, auditable Figma development plugin that creates native local Variables, Styles, Components, Component Sets, Variants, Component Properties and Auto Layout in the "Hermes OS – Design System" file. No network, no telemetry, deterministic and idempotent.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

//: This package intentionally declares NO dependencies. Its scripts resolve tsc and vitest from the repository root node_modules (npx walks up). It must not create its own lockfile and must not change the repository package manager.
